name: com.assaysecurity/assay
description: Security scanner for vibe-coded and AI-built apps. Checks a live URL from the outside — no code access — for secrets exposed in the browser bundle, a database readable without a login (Supabase RLS off, Firebase rules open), public file storage, exposed config files, and missing security headers. Returns plain-English findings with the exact fix. Built for apps made with Lovable, Bolt, Replit, v0 and Cursor.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key from https://assaysecurity.com/settings/keys (starts with assay_sk_).
